title: Act: Create the useUiStore Zustand store
summary: Implement uiStore with state and actions
description: Create the store module with typed state and actions.
acceptance_criteria: useUiStore exports state and all actions

steps.action: Define type UiModal = 'contribution' | 'settings' | null; interface UiState with drawerOpen, modal, soundEnabled, settingsOpen and actions toggleDrawer, setDrawerOpen(open), openModal(m), closeModal, toggleSound, setSettingsOpen(open); export useUiStore = create<UiState>() with initial drawerOpen false, modal null, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false
steps.code: export const useUiStore = create<UiState>()((set) => ({ drawerOpen: false, modal: null, soundEnabled: true, settingsOpen: false, toggleDrawer: () => set((s) => ({ drawerOpen: !s.drawerOpen })), setDrawerOpen: (drawerOpen) => set({ drawerOpen }), openModal: (modal) => set({ modal }), closeModal: () => set({ modal: null }), toggleSound: () => set((s) => ({ soundEnabled: !s.soundEnabled })), setSettingsOpen: (settingsOpen) => set({ settingsOpen }) }));
steps.expected: tsc --noEmit passes with the new module
